statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ b : ℕ, 2≤b → ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D ⊆ Finset.range b → 2≤D.card → ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, let S := (Finset.range (b^k)).filter (fun n : ℕ => ∀ i < k, (n/b^(i))%b ∈ D); (((S).filter (fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n ∧ (Nat.dist p q)^3≤n^2)).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(1+(S.card:ℝ))^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 数字受限的偶数，用距中心至多 O(n^(2/3)) 的素数给出表示，保留族内幂节省。
plain_statement.en: Localize prime pairs near the center on a digit-restricted target family.

brief.zh: 文献的素数对没有间距条件。控制移动短素数和与数字 Fourier 乘积的相关，界按数字集合大小计。
brief.en: Estimate moving prime sums against the sparse digital measure; dropping the distance condition recovers unrestricted pairs.
